pages.title: Prepare early, shed smart, restore promptly
pages.text: Winterize before winter. When deep cold is forecast, commit units, import, and ask for conservation early. If supply is falling, shed ahead but protect gas facilities. Restore homes once reserves recover.

pages.title: Spend winter money where freezing hurts
pages.text: Most lost power came from frozen gas plants and wells. Put the winter budget there first instead of spreading it thinly over wind, coal and batteries.

pages.title: Big outages with big reserves unwind
pages.text: If many homes are dark while spare power is plentiful, bring them back steadily each hour. Darkness without a power shortage is a failure, not safety.

pages.title: Freeze-proof the plants that froze
pages.text: Gas and coal plants froze and dragged supply down for days. Spend the winter budget finishing their weatherproofing rather than on backup fuel few plants used.

pages.title: Fund freeze-proofing before backup fuel
pages.text: Frozen wells and coal plants caused the shortfall, while backup fuel was rarely used. Move that money into weatherproofing wells and coal plants so less supply freezes when the cold peaks.

pages.title: Protect wind turbines from icing
pages.text: In deep cold most wind turbines iced up and stopped, the only fleet left unprotected. Weatherproofing part of it keeps more power flowing when demand peaks.

strategy:
- Lead with physical build edits (winterizing, fuel supply, weatherproofing wind, wells and coal) that target the failure mode named in the failed storms. Predict -10% to -15% for broad builds; builds have measured -7% to -18%.
- Make the second idea either another distinct build or an unwind of oversized outages only (the one kept rule type). Never add triggers that shed earlier or larger, and never act on near-threshold margins.
- For any rule, habit or briefing edit, predict 0% to +5% by default. Narrow tweaks have measured slightly positive (+2.8, +2.9, +5.7). Predict negative only if the failed storms show a large, specific loss it removes.
- Check each edit against the passed contrast storm and state the calm-day cost. If any shedding could fire on a healthy-margin day, drop the edit; don't just shrink its prediction.
- Size build predictions by how often the targeted failure appears in the shown storms. Widespread failures get about -15%, single-storm failures about -7%.
- Don't re-propose rejected ideas reworded (moderate-margin unwinds, deep-cold habits, reserve-drain triggers, cushions during outages).

sensors.name: supply_drop
sensors.description: how fast supply is changing per hour over the last 3 hours (negative = falling)

rules.description: Deep cold forecast within 48h: commit extra units, line up imports, ask for conservation before the cold arrives
Thin reserves: use demand response, batteries and conservation before cutting homes
Supply falling with thin reserves: shed ahead of the drop while keeping gas facilities powered
Reserves recovered and supply steady: bring homes back gradually but promptly

guardrails.description: Frequency sagging: control room cuts load immediately, never gas facilities
Whenever shedding, keep gas facilities powered to avoid the gas-supply feedback loop
Large outages while reserves are ample and supply is not collapsing: restore 1500 MW per hour

alerts.description: Reserves getting thin: ask the AI
Wake the AI when deep cold is forecast, supply is falling fast, or reserves are thinning

rules.description: Deep cold forecast within 48h: commit extra units, line up imports, ask for conservation before the cold arrives
Thin reserves: use demand response, batteries and conservation before cutting homes
Supply falling with thin reserves: shed ahead of the drop while keeping gas facilities powered
Reserves recovered and supply steady: bring homes back gradually but promptly

guardrails.description: Frequency sagging: control room cuts load immediately, never gas facilities
Whenever shedding, keep gas facilities powered to avoid the gas-supply feedback loop
Large outages while reserves are ample and supply is not collapsing: restore 1500 MW per hour

alerts.description: Reserves getting thin: ask the AI
Wake the AI when deep cold is forecast, supply is falling fast, or reserves are thinning
